## Aymeric Nadjem - Engineer, PhD in neuroscience

I develop analysis tools that are designed to be user-friendly for everyone using a browser. This site showcases some of my projects and teaching resources, along with a few interactive demos. Unfortunately, not everything can currently be run in a browser, so you may need to pre-process your data locally or by using a container (or just ask me).

You will mostly find encrypted notebooks here, which means that you asked me to obtain the code :) Once you have it and your browser has downloaded the necessary packages, it can even work without an internet connection!
